parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the window, RFC 3339 (default `to` minus 30 days).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive end of the window, RFC 3339 (default now). `to` minus `from` is at most 366 days.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: Restrict the report to one site.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Bucket size; `day` is the only value.
